# E0716: a lens computes a value CEL, the compiled lens language, does not compute the same way

A compiled lens computes its values in CEL. Where CUE and CEL disagree on an
operation for some input, the compiled lens would translate that input
differently from Go, so the lineage does not compile. Here strings.ToUpper maps
case per Unicode in CUE and per ASCII in CEL.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
import "strings"

name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				s: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				s:  string
				up: string
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			s:  v0_0.s
			up: strings.ToUpper(v0_0.s)
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			s: v1_0.s
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0716]: up in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 computes a value CEL, the compiled lens language, does not compute the same way
  --> lineage.cue:22:2
   |
22 |     "0.0->1.0": {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^
   |
   = note: up in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 calls strings.ToUpper, whose CEL counterpart changes ASCII only (Cap'n Proto rule cel-unrenderable)
   = help: use the operation CEL computes alike, such as quo for / or strings.Contains for strings.Index
```
